caso.texto:
A supplier wants to sell one service to Ohio and Pune without confirmed local support, billing currency or tax treatment. An invitation says 10:00 without date or zone. The seller assumes English and WhatsApp for everyone. Buyers require different reviewers.

Build an Ohio scenario with an IT contractor, procurement review and America/New_York scheduling on an actual date. The buyer prefers email and needs a written scope. No inference about all US buyers follows from this case.

projeto.instrucoes: Prepare two independent briefs, complete invitations and an offer/contracting/communication issue matrix. Explain why currency conversion alone is insufficient.
projeto.gabarito: Confirm eligibility, delivery capability and terms before proposing. Use dated city-based time zones and verify conversion. Ask language/channel preferences and involve the specific reviewers. Invent no support, tax, timing or international payment conditions.

avaliacao_basica.observacao: Não substitui banco profissional de 40 questões / Does not replace a 40-question professional bank

simulacao.instrucao_ator: Play the fictional buyer. Reveal supplied facts when asked; say you need to verify unknowns. Do not teach or score during dialogue. After three turns raise a timing or scope concern; in a second round request closure.
simulacao.instrucao_avaliador: Use only the transcript and rubric. Cite evidence, identify gaps and request human review for uncertain scores. Do not issue certificates or approve contracts.
